decisions.reason: Its close fit with the firm's established earmold expertise and the absence of a reported shortfall suggest it meets aspirations and can be carried with existing slack.
As a custom in-ear earmold presented on its own page, it is integrated with current offerings and shows no performance gap, so the firm keeps it.
